claim: Forecast accuracy can conceal unfaithful known-future-covariate response
required_evidence: Paired intervention forecasts on frozen DGPs; target-only and covariate-aware loss; series-cluster bootstrap intervals
acceptance: P0 gate passes exactly as frozen and at least one failure satisfies the complementary accuracy condition

required_evidence: Formal metric definitions; unit tests on analytic oracle and deliberately broken forecasters; invariance tests
acceptance: All metrics recover expected values on controlled positive negative and scale-transformed fixtures

claim: Failure profiles vary by mechanism and backbone
required_evidence: Complete mechanism-by-backbone matrix with identical generators interventions horizons and aggregation
acceptance: Predeclared interaction summaries and all cells reported without universal-superiority language

claim: A lightweight safeguard can reduce a verified failure without material clean-skill loss
required_evidence: Untouched mechanisms or tasks; frozen safeguard; matched baselines and ablations
acceptance: Authorized only after P0; improvement interval excludes zero and relative clean SQL loss is at most 2%
